Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the evidence and conflated incorporation (1914) with the founding date, despite sources (Canadian Encyclopedia, NCWC site, and Wikipedia) indicating the NCWC was founded in 1893 (formally begun on October 27, 1893). The Planner then prematurely finalized the task with the incorrect year.
